Subject: Urgent: Clarification Required for HDFC Bank Wire Transfer #WR-89204

Our monitoring systems flagged an international wire transfer of 45,000 USD initiated on October 12 to Meridian Global Supplies Ltd. in Singapore. To prevent potential unauthorized processing, this transaction has been temporarily held.

Please reply to this email directly with the following details to confirm the legitimacy of this request:
